kinds.about: LayeredFS and code mods: one folder per 16-digit title id holding code.ips or code.bps, exheader.bin, exefs/, romfs/ and romfs_ext/, exactly as a mod's instructions put them in Azahar's load/mods/<title id>.
kinds.doc: Azahar fbd3fb0 reads load/mods/<016X> only, uppercase (ncch_container.cpp:275-277): exheader.bin (:275-292), the first of exefs/code.ips, exefs/code.bps, code.ips, code.bps (:500-541), code.bin, icon.bin, banner.bnr and logo.bcma.lz at the title level or under exefs/ (:551-567), romfs/ and romfs_ext/ as LayeredFS (:627-637). A header Azahar refuses stops the game from booting (patch.cpp:21-24 PATCH, :161-164 BPS1 with no metadata; core/loader/ncch.cpp:167-169), so such an entry is reported and not linked. Nothing writes there outside an explicit RomFS dump (layered_fs.cpp:551-579), and it follows links through stat (file_util.cpp:179, 207), so each title folder is linked.

kinds.about: HD texture packs: one folder per 16-digit title id holding the pack's .png or .dds files (any subfolders) and its pack.json if it has one, as Azahar's load/textures/<title id>. Only a game with a pack loads textures, at the scale Semu draws its top screen.
kinds.doc: custom_tex_manager.cpp:315-320 creates load/textures/<016X> only when it is absent, an empty real folder in state that the next launch replaces with the link; :374-386 scans the pack recursively; dumps go to dump/ (:175-200, 247-252), so nothing writes inside a linked pack. The switch is per title: config/azahar-emu/custom/<016X>.ini, loaded by program id at boot (citra_qt.cpp:1507-1514, config.cpp:114-115), with use_global=false (ReadGlobalSetting, config.cpp:192-199); every other game keeps custom_textures off and pays nothing (rasterizer_cache.h:1022, custom_tex_manager.cpp:290-293). Packs load lazily on worker threads (async_custom_loading, :300-311) and are never preloaded, which would read every texture before boot (:207-239). resolution_factor (0-10, settings.h:551) renders the game at the whole multiple Semu draws its top screen at, 2 at 1280x800, so the pack is not sampled down to 400x240.

mods.doc: The library is <paths.mods>/azahar/<library>/<title id>; each title folder is linked into ${state_root}/data/azahar-emu/load, which stays a real folder.

doc.launch: The source-built Azahar binary consumes --fullscreen followed by one positional ROM path.
doc.state: Azahar reads configuration from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/azahar-emu and keeps NAND, SDMC saves, save states, cache, and logs below the isolated $XDG_DATA_HOME/$XDG_CACHE_HOME state roots. Named key files are first-run copies; external sources are never modified.
doc.rendering: Vulkan on both platforms (Apple builds have no OpenGL renderer). render_vulkan composes Semu's bezel and shader into the swapchain image at present: on Linux through VK_LAYER_SEMU_compositor, on macOS through Semu's stand-in for MoltenVK (lib/semu-vulkan). The semu-touch patch maps a click on the composed picture back to Azahar's own layout.
doc.display: Azahar's Qt window refuses shared OpenGL contexts on the Wayland platform plugin; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb runs it on XWayland.
doc.content: What Azahar boots at its pinned fbd3fb02, by extension (src/core/loader/loader.cpp:51-61: ELF, CCI and CXI, 3DSX, and their z-compressed forms). A .cia is installed into the NAND, not booted, so it is not listed.

save_states.doc: Quick Save and Quick Load use Azahar's one quick-save slot; there is no slot to choose.

menu.doc: Seen 2026-10-03 in the podman VM (tests/integration/menu-pause.sh, Pushmo on lavapipe through VK_LAYER_SEMU_compositor): paused with its own pause key, Azahar presents nothing (async_presentation=false presents from the emulation thread), so a menu record written while paused stayed invisible until it resumed. The Semu menu therefore opens over the running game, and on Linux it holds the pad while it is open (EVIOCGRAB once every pad is at rest, released after the closing press), so the game sees none of the menu's input; taps and Steam's radial keys still reach it.
